positioning.audience: Operators delegating consequential work to multiple AI agents while retaining explicit authority, priorities, escalation, and accountability.

positioning.hero_headline: The operating system for agentic organizations.
positioning.hero_support: Give agents distinct roles, bounded authority, and shared direction—so the organization keeps moving without constant supervision.

intent.core_idea: A swarm becomes an organization without surrendering member identity and judgement.
intent.functional_truth: Distinct agent roles coordinate through bounded authority, accountable claims, temporary handoffs, escalation and mission-to-task structure.
intent.sibling_distinction: Ateles governs who can act and how work is coordinated; Neotoma preserves what is true.

positioning.product_promise: A standing agentic organization that can keep coordinated work moving without constant supervision.
positioning.sibling_role: Ateles answers who was authorized; Neotoma answers what was true.

relative_sizing.requirement: Use relative responsive sizing and preserve resize/reflow without two-dimensional page scrolling.

cinematic.palette_and_material: Warm paper and ink, rust coordination signals, restrained grant green, tactile ceramic/metal/paper materials.
prohibitions: literal insects, monkeys, spiders, robots, hives, or honeycomb
cinematic.semantics: A swarm becomes an organization: autonomous differentiated members self-organize around shared purpose, exchange work through temporary handoffs, pause at one bounded checkpoint or escalation, then continue.

delivery.hero: One silent 8-second 4:3 master, 720p or better, with H.264 and VP9/AV1 web encodes; each hero asset under 1.8 MB.
delivery.responsive: Provide 16:9 desktop and art-directed 9:16 mobile crops without losing the semantic beat.
delivery.sections: Five-to-six-second silent 16:9 masters or still-led micro-loops; target under 900 KB per moving web asset and under 150 KB per AVIF poster.

aesthetic_territory.identity: Organization is the promise; swarm is the symbol; governance and authority are the structure; the seal is only a secondary authorization or completion marker. Members retain distinct shape, surface, and path. No permanent edges or central hub.
aesthetic_territory.name: Coordinated agency in motion
aesthetic_territory.originality_basis: Distinctiveness comes from product truth—member identity, bounded authority, accountable work ownership, temporary handoff, escalation, and continuation—not arbitrary novelty.
aesthetic_territory.palette_material_light: Warm paper and deep ink; rust for coordination; grant green only at bounded authorization; ceramic, patinated metal, woven paper, shallow atmospheric depth, and warm directional light.
aesthetic_territory.product_truth: Ateles turns multiple agent actors into a standing agentic organization through persistent roles, bounded authority, accountable claims and leases, mission-to-task priority, escalation, and continued action.

aesthetic_territory.scope_statement: Internal creative platform subordinate to the settled category “The operating system for agentic organizations.” It is not an alternate category noun, public headline, or tagline.
aesthetic_territory.summary: An edge-free abstract swarm of differentiated semi-autonomous members organizes around shared purpose through proximity, orientation, temporary signals, and short-lived handoffs.
aesthetic_territory.typography_layout: Geometric expressive headings, humanist productive copy, and short public operational labels; cinematic fields dominate with concise text in a protected safe zone.

anti_patterns: Do not use the seal as Ateles's logo, hero object, or primary metaphor. It is only a secondary state marker for a concrete authorization, commitment, approval, or completed checkpoint.
Do not literalize “swarm” with monkeys, spiders, insects, hives, honeycombs, or mascot clusters. Show a living collective through abstract named roles and relationships.
Do not render an anonymous neural-network mesh. Every visible node or path must communicate an organizational role, relationship, handoff, priority, or intervention state.

Never expose internal record IDs, entity types, field or decision keys, code-call names, repository filenames, phase bookkeeping, agent instructions, or bracketed internal scope notation on a public page.
Do not paste research analysis, source citations, or implementation-review notes into public prose. Preserve evidence in linked source artifacts and translate it into concise reader-facing claims.
Do not let motion carry organizational meaning that disappears under reduced-motion preferences; the static graph must remain legible and complete.
Do not spread authorization or withdrawal colors as general accents; reserve them for active versus withdrawn, expired, or paused authority.
Do not diverge shared structural tokens from Neotoma without a product reason; the products remain siblings through spacing, restraint, and hierarchy.
Do not reuse the Neotoma app or Inspector palette. Ateles keeps its warm paper and ink system with a rust coordination accent.
visual_styles.camera: Stable three-quarter top-down or low oblique compositions; one measured push or drift; enough depth to read members as an organization rather than points.
visual_styles.composition: Visually dominant scenes with intentional copy-safe space. Distinct roles must remain legible at nav/logo scale and expand into a richer living collective in hero media.
visual_styles.light: Warm directional studio light with restrained contrast and disciplined negative space.

background_rules.guidance: Use calm warm-paper or deep-ink fields; avoid busy imagery.

misuse_rules: Do not stretch, rotate, crop, mask, outline, shadow or redraw the mark.
Do not add permanent edges, a central hub, literal insects, honeycomb or the seal as primary symbol.

visual_styles.material: Tactile ceramic, powder-coated metal, woven paper, subtle ground shadows, and one small glasslike checkpoint token.
visual_styles.motion: Members begin independently, align without losing shape, exchange one work object through brief signals, pause only the bounded path at a small checkpoint, then continue; paths disappear after handoff.

palette.rationale: Swarm coordination, not wax-seal brand theater: the warm paper and ink base makes the system feel inhabited and legible, while rust traces relationships, handoffs, and directed motion among differentiated roles. Green remains semantic and reserved for active authorization; revoked remains reserved for withdrawn or expired authority. A small seal survives only as a secondary state marker attached to an authorization, commitment, or completed checkpoint—not as the product symbol or ambient palette rationale.
